title: Study of Olatorepatide in Adult Participants Living With Overweight or Obesity Without Diabetes
note: Simplified for the demo, not the full protocol. Key criteria only.

criteria.text: BMI 30 to under 45, or BMI 27 or higher with at least one weight-related condition: hypertension, dyslipidemia, prediabetes, obstructive sleep apnea, coronary artery disease, heart failure or cerebrovascular disease

rules.label: hypertension, hyperlipidemia, hypertriglyceridemia, prediabetes, sleep apnea, ischemic heart disease, myocardial infarction, heart failure or stroke

criteria.text: Previous or current diagnosis of type 1 or type 2 diabetes
criteria.notes: Metformin alone isn't treated as diabetes because it's also prescribed for prediabetes, which this trial allows.

criteria.text: Body weight changed more than 5 kg in about the last 3 months
criteria.notes: Excludes only when the record shows a change of more than 5 kg in the last 3 months. With fewer than 2 weights in that window it passes here and is confirmed at screening (most patients are weighed about once a year).

criteria.text: Bariatric surgery, including any revision, reversal or removal
History of acute or chronic pancreatitis, cholecystitis or symptomatic gallstones
criteria.notes: A gallbladder removal counts as a sign of past symptomatic gallstones or cholecystitis.

criteria.text: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2
criteria.reason: Family history isn't in the record. Ask the patient or check the chart.
